_description: ±15% range, 30 levels. Backtested on three BTC market regimes: +5.0%/90d (+20%/yr) on lateral 2026, -3.3% loss on LUNA crash bear 2022 (stops after 9%), +0.1% on Oct-Jan 2024-25 bull run (stops after 25%). Best for expected ranging/consolidating conditions — tighter step means more cycles per day when price oscillates. Recalibrate grid_lower/grid_upper when BTC moves significantly (target ±15% from current price). Capital must equal grid_levels × grid_order_size_usdt.

_backtest.bear_2022: -3.3% loss — stops after 9% of period (LUNA crash -54%)
